description: Bounded arXiv discovery plan for the initial Agent/RAG research corpus.

queries.name: agentic_rag
queries.search_query: all:"retrieval augmented generation" AND (all:agent OR all:agentic)

queries.name: adaptive_reflective_rag
queries.search_query: all:"retrieval augmented generation" AND (all:adaptive OR all:reflective OR all:corrective)
queries.openalex_search: adaptive reflective corrective retrieval augmented generation

queries.name: llm_agents
queries.search_query: all:"large language model" AND (all:agent OR all:agents)

queries.name: tool_using_agents
queries.search_query: all:"language model" AND (all:"tool use" OR all:"tool learning")
queries.openalex_search: language model agents tool use tool learning

queries.name: knowledge_graph_rag
queries.search_query: all:"knowledge graph" AND all:"retrieval augmented generation"

queries.name: multi_agent_llm
queries.search_query: (all:"multi-agent" OR all:"multi agent") AND all:"language model"

queries.name: agent_planning_memory
queries.search_query: all:"language model agent" AND (all:planning OR all:memory)
queries.openalex_search: large language model agent planning memory

queries.name: agent_evaluation
queries.search_query: all:"language model agent" AND (all:evaluation OR all:benchmark)
queries.openalex_search: large language model agents evaluation benchmark

queries.name: multi_hop_graph_rag
queries.search_query: all:"retrieval augmented generation" AND (all:"multi-hop" OR all:graph)
queries.openalex_search: multi hop graph retrieval augmented generation question answering

queries.name: scientific_rag_qa
queries.search_query: all:"retrieval augmented generation" AND (all:scientific OR all:literature)
queries.openalex_search: scientific literature question answering retrieval augmented generation
